units.source_text: 篝火，随着急流快速地荡近我们明亮的心，已经看见黑色的船体了。

en.t: The bonfire, riding the swift current, came rushing toward our brightened hearts, and the black hull of the boat had already come into view.

units.source_text: 开始看见火焰在摇曳，也可以看见渔夫、养鱼鹰人和船夫了。

en.t: We began to see the flames flickering, and we could also make out the fishermen, the cormorant handlers, and the boatmen.

units.source_text: 响起了船夫用橹敲击船舷的激越声音，也传来篝火熊熊燃烧的噼啪声。

en.t: The fierce sound of the boatmen striking the gunwales with their oars rang out, and the crackle of the bonfires burning high reached us as well.

units.source_text: 船儿沿着河滩漾到我们旅馆所在的河岸这边来。

en.t: The boats drifted along the riverbank toward the shore where our inn stood.
The boats flew with the current.

units.source_text: 我们站在簇簇的篝火之中。

en.t: We stood among clusters of bonfires.

units.source_text: 鱼鹰在船边拍打着翅膀。

en.t: The cormorants beat their wings beside the boats.

units.source_text: 忽然间，流动的东西、潜流的东西、漂浮的东西、

en.t: All at once, the things that flowed, the things that slipped beneath the current, the things that floated,

units.source_text: 渔夫用右手扳开鱼鹰的嘴让它吐出来的香鱼，全都像魔鬼节那些又细又黑、身体灵便的怪物一样。

en.t: even the sweetfish that the fisherman pried from a cormorant's mouth with his right hand and made it spit out, all seemed like slender, black, agile monsters from a demon festival.

units.source_text: 水上的一叶小舟上就有十六只鱼鹰，真不知先看哪只才好。

en.t: There were sixteen cormorants on a single small boat on the water, and I truly did not know which one to look at first.

units.source_text: 渔夫站在船首，利落地解开了拴住十二只鱼鹰的绳子。

en.t: The fisherman stood at the bow and deftly untied the ropes that held twelve cormorants.

units.source_text: 船首的篝火烧着水，从旅馆二楼看去，很像是香鱼。

en.t: The bonfire at the bow seemed to burn the water, and from the second floor of the inn it looked very much like a sweetfish.
